capabilities: Search the web for selected text from the right-click menu
Search the web for a note title from the file explorer or a tab
Define custom search engines with a {query} placeholder
Strip Markdown links, bold, highlights and list markers from the selection before searching
Run the searches from the command palette so they can get hotkeys
disambiguation: Not a search of the vault; it opens the chosen search engine's results page in your browser.
extras: The plugin sends nothing itself; it opens the search address in the browser, so the chosen engine sees the searched text. The README also lists the author's other plugins.
problem: Obsidian offers no quick way to send selected text or a note title out to a web search engine.
summary: Adds right-click and command palette entries that search the web for selected text or a note title, using search engines you define.
